title: Sending the Lien Payoff on a Traded Vehicle — Trade-In Agreements
content:
Kestrel pays off the loan or lease on a vehicle traded under **Trade-In Agreements** directly to the lienholder, and the payoff charge is borne by the trade equity.

## Rule

The lien payoff on a picked-up trade-in agreement is sent to the lienholder relying on the latest recorded payoff quote, and the payoff charge is booked as one lien payoff entry naming that quote, dated the send date, lowering the undistributed trade equity by its amount; any per diem Kestrel absorbs is paid by Kestrel on top of the payoff charge and never touches the trade equity.

## When the payoff is sent and fixed

Where the payoff charge exceeds the undistributed trade equity, the lien payoff is not sent until the customer has paid in the part of the shortfall that no financing roll-in covers.

The payoff charge is fixed only after the agreement's ledger carries the mileage deduction due on an inspected mileage above the stated mileage.

Put the other way round: a payoff charge that the trade equity does not cover waits for the customer's own payment of whatever part of the shortfall no financing roll-in covers.

## Business effect

| Item | Effect |
|---|---|
| Agreement history | One lien payoff entry naming the quote relied on, dated the send date |
| Undistributed trade equity | Lower by the payoff charge |
| Per diem Kestrel absorbs | Paid by Kestrel on top of the payoff charge; not charged against the trade equity |

## Care console reference: `send_lien_payoff_9460d1ba`

**Capability.** Releases the payoff of the loan or lease on one picked-up traded vehicle to its lienholder, relying on one recorded payoff quote, and charges it against the customer's trade equity. One call books a lien payoff entry dated today that names the quote relied on, for the amount given, and lowers the agreement's undistributed trade equity by that same amount; the entry shows in the agreement's history as the payoff sent on the customer's old loan.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`, then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`, naming `send_lien_payoff_9460d1ba`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `trade_in_id` | Reference number of the customer's trade-in agreement, as shown by the trade-in agreement lookup for this customer | Id |
| `source_txn_id` | Reference number of the payoff quote entry relied on, as shown in the agreement's history by the trade-in history lookup | Id |
| `payoff_amount` | The payoff amount charged against the trade equity | USD, a positive amount to 2 decimal places (rounded to the nearest cent) |

**Return.** A text rendering of a receipt with `entry_id` (reference number of the payoff entry), `trade_in_id`, `source_txn_id` (the quote entry relied on), `amount` (USD to 2 decimal places, the payoff amount booked), `sent_on` (YYYY-MM-DD) and `equity_balance` (USD to 2 decimal places, the undistributed trade equity with the payoff booked). A receipt carrying an `entry_id` means the payoff is sent and booked.
